critical_findings.tfidf_174k_formal_suite_complete: All 8 TF-IDF representations evaluated at 173,963 decisions on frozen harness v3. All PASS both adversarial gates (language_dominance < 0.85, jurist_pairwise > 0.5). Best: cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 (LangDom=0.477, JP=0.735). Fundamental two-mode tradeoff persists: citation-based (cited_decisions) dominate jurist preference; text-based (regeste/full_text) fail adversarial lang_dom ~0.999.
critical_findings.citation_heritage_174k_validated: Frozen pair pool (1,020 positive/negative) from 174k citation-ID resolution (2,019/2,105 resolved). Citation-based modes PASS (AUC 0.70-0.74), text-based FAIL (AUC 0.50-0.65). Confirms citation signals recover citation heritage; text signals do not.
critical_findings.v17b_label_normalization_174k: Tested on 15k subsample (213->111 labels). Purity ratios 5x-10x but NMI decreases on normalized labels. Different regime from v17b 1K scale (104->54 labels, 1.15-1.25x ratios). Normalization merges labels embeddings were separating. Does NOT generalize in same-magnitude sense.
critical_findings.v18_coarse_hierarchy_negative: Even at 4-label branch level: best purity 0.65 (linear_citation_concat) < 0.7 threshold. NMI ~0.004-0.30. Fundamental hierarchy limitation confirmed for TF-IDF/citation representations.
